title: 开始阅读最后更新：2026-07-21 01:21:36 最新章节：第2091章 冰璇月的担忧
content_zh:
傲武大陆历经了洪荒、远古、上古时代的演变，到了现在的万法时代！
在这个时代万族鼎盛，宗派林立，修炼体系多样（练气，练体，练血。
修佛，修道，修魔。
有人修，妖修，魔修），强大的生物层出不穷！
妖孽也是争先竞艳。
同样也是强者为尊的吃“人”
时代！
南陵城，萧家大院的西南角，这里的地面杂草丛生，四周都是残垣断壁，正值腊月的寒风吹过，卷起残枝碎叶，偶有鸦叫一两声传入这里。
萧家作为南陵城的霸主之一，在它的宅院中居然有这样的地方也是出奇的很。
只见在这个破院中唯一一间旧房子前正站着一位豆英俊少年。
观其模样，年纪不出十六，长得剑眉星目，身材挺拔，高六尺（一尺大约三十三厘米）。
身上穿着一件洗得发白的长衫，长发整齐的束好。
微风吹过，长发自由的飘荡，有点瘦弱的身躯显得有点孤单影只！
这个时候，少年正努力的挥舞着手中的重剑。
每一招每一试都切合道运，小小年纪能有如此造诣已经是难得的人中龙凤。
美中不足的是周身没有灵气的波动。
正在此时破败的房门被敲响！
一声清脆的声音的传来：“二少爷，族长在大厅等你。”
这是萧家族长萧玄策身边的众多丫鬟中最不起眼的一个，名叫小翠。
而丫鬟口中的二少爷正是眼前的少年，也是萧家族长的二儿子萧天。

萧天，十二岁开始修炼，历经了四年，硬是连一个屁都没有练出来。
所谓最简单就能入门的炼气没有成功，更不要说其他的修炼体系了。
唯一感到有进步的就是身体比普通人强大十倍。
所以即使是现在手握百斤重剑依然能挥洒自如。
也是因为不能修炼的原因，现在萧天在萧玄策的眼里就显得格外的刺眼。
毕竟在傲武这个以强为尊的世界没有实力就没有出人头地的机会。
也就可能一直被压迫，被欺凌。
其实现在已经体现出来了，本来因为是族长之子，能够在家族中备受尊重。
但自从修炼两年依然不能入门，情况就悄然发生了转变。
不难看出，就连身份低微的丫鬟都对这个族长之子等闲视之。
加上自从懂事开始，萧天就没有见到过他的母亲。
每每问起他父亲萧玄策，都是避而不谈。
只是眼中一闪而过的哀伤和忧愁就显得格外的刺眼。
由于萧天年纪尚小，所以也没有察觉。
当然，所有人对萧天的轻视都是从四年前家族强者判定他没有紫府丹田开始的。
但不知道，从两年前萧天已经发生翻天覆地的变化了………
小翠的声音使得正在练剑的少年停下了手中的动作。
循声望去，只见身着碧绿纱衣，身材凹凸有致的女子站在门口。
content_en:
Aowu Continent has gone through the evolution of prehistoric times, ancient times, and ancient times, and has reached the current era of Wanfa!
In this era, all races are at their peak, there are many sects, and there are various cultivation systems (qi training, body training, blood training).
Cultivate Buddhism, Taoism, and demons.
There are people cultivators, demon cultivators, demon cultivators), powerful creatures emerge in endlessly!
Monsters are also vying to be the first to be beautiful.
He also eats "people" who respect the strong.
Times!
Nanling City, the southwest corner of the Xiao family compound, the ground here is overgrown with weeds and surrounded by ruins. The cold wind of the twelfth lunar month blows through, rolling up the broken branches and leaves. Occasionally, one or two crows are heard coming here.
As one of the overlords of Nanling City, it is surprising that the Xiao family has such a place in its mansion.
I saw a handsome young man standing in front of the only old house in this dilapidated courtyard.
Judging from his appearance, he is no more than sixteen years old. He has sharp eyebrows and starry eyes, a tall and straight figure, and is six feet tall (one foot is about 33 centimeters).
He was wearing a washed white gown, and his long hair was neatly tied up.
The breeze blows, the long hair is flowing freely, and the thin body looks a little lonely!
At this time, the boy was trying hard to swing the heavy sword in his hand.
Every move and every attempt is in line with the luck of the Tao. It is already rare to have such attainments at a young age.
The only drawback is that there is no fluctuation of spiritual energy in the whole body.
At this moment, there was a knock on the dilapidated door!
A clear voice came: "Second Young Master, the patriarch is waiting for you in the hall."
This is the most inconspicuous of the many maids around Xiao Xuance, the head of the Xiao family, named Xiaocui.
The second young master the maid mentioned was the young man in front of her, Xiao Tian, ​​the second son of the head of the Xiao family.
Xiao Tian started practicing at the age of twelve. After four years, he still couldn't even practice a single thing.
The so-called qi refining, which is the easiest to get started with, has not been successful, let alone other cultivation systems.
The only thing that feels like progress is that the body is ten times stronger than ordinary people.
So even now I can still wield it with ease even if I hold a hundred-jin epee in my hand.
Also because he was unable to practice, Xiao Tian now looked particularly dazzling in Xiao Xuance's eyes.
After all, in Aowu, a world where strength is respected, there is no chance of getting ahead without strength.
You may always be oppressed and bullied.
In fact, it has now been reflected. Originally, because he was the son of the clan leader, he was highly respected in the family.
But since practicing for two years and still not being able to get started, the situation has quietly changed.
It was not difficult to see that even the lowly maid looked down upon the patriarch's son.
In addition, Xiao Tian has not seen his mother since he was sensible.
Whenever he asked about his father Xiao Xuance, he avoided talking about it.
Just the flash of sadness and sorrow in his eyes was particularly dazzling.
Because Xiao Tian was still young, he didn't notice it.
Of course, everyone's contempt for Xiao Tian began four years ago when the powerful family members judged that he did not have Zifu Dantian.
But I don’t know that Xiao Tian has undergone earth-shaking changes since two years ago...
Xiao Cui's voice caused the young man who was practicing his sword to stop what he was doing.
Looking around, I saw a woman wearing a green gauze dress with a curvy figure standing at the door.
